title: AK870 FN sheet
blurb: Wired-only. Side LEDs are a separate cycle from the keycaps. Skip the wireless driver package.
footer: FN+Enter cycles the side strip; FN+' colors it. FN+X kills keys and sides together. No VIA.

groups.label: RGB
groups.hint: 18 onboard effects — no Windows app needed

groups.label: Media
groups.hint: F-row changes with Win / Mac mode

groups.label: System
groups.hint: OS swap, Win lock, factory reset

combos.title: Cycle 18 effects
combos.detail: Walks the full effect list, including an off state at the end of the loop. Tap until the board goes dark if you want lights out.

combos.title: Brightness up
combos.detail: Five steps. The whole board flashes three times at the top.

combos.title: Brightness down
combos.detail: Five steps. Keep tapping — at the bottom the backlight turns off.

combos.title: Effect direction
combos.detail: Flips left/right on wave and flow effects.

combos.title: Color
combos.detail: RGB, then red · orange · yellow · green · cyan · blue · purple · white.

combos.title: Speed down
combos.detail: Five steps. Flashes three times at the slowest setting.

combos.title: Speed up
combos.detail: Five steps. Flashes three times at the fastest setting.

combos.title: Lights on / off
combos.detail: Hard toggle. Fastest way to kill RGB without cycling effects.

combos.title: FPS preset
combos.detail: Lights WASD, arrows, and 1. Hold FN + ~ after this to recolor it.

combos.title: MOBA preset
combos.detail: QWER, DFGBV, Ctrl, Alt, Tab, Space, 1–6, Esc.

combos.title: Alphas preset
combos.detail: Letters plus punctuation and arrows — the “office” mask.

combos.title: Record a preset
combos.detail: Select FN+1 / 2 / 3 first. FN+` starts recording (indicators flash). Tap a key to cycle 8 colors, tap again to turn that key off. FN+` saves.

combos.title: Side light effects
combos.detail: Cycles the case side-strip (5 on wired V2, 6 on tri-mode). Keep tapping — one step is usually off. Independent of the keycaps.

combos.title: Side light color
combos.detail: Static / breathe only: red · green · blue · yellow · purple · cyan · white.

combos.title: F1
combos.detail: Win: media player. Mac: display brightness down.

combos.title: F2
combos.detail: Win: volume down. Mac: display brightness up.

combos.title: F3
combos.detail: Win: volume up. Mac: Mission Control.

combos.title: F4
combos.detail: Win: mute. Mac: Launchpad / console.

combos.title: F5
combos.detail: Win: stop. Mac: keyboard light down.

combos.title: F6
combos.detail: Win: previous track. Mac: keyboard light up.

combos.title: F7
combos.detail: Win: play / pause. Mac: previous track.

combos.title: F8
combos.detail: Win: next track. Mac: play / pause.

combos.title: F9
combos.detail: Win: mail. Mac: next track.

combos.title: F10
combos.detail: Win: browser. Mac: mute.

combos.title: F11
combos.detail: Win: This PC. Mac: volume down.

combos.title: F12
combos.detail: Win: calculator. Mac: volume up.

combos.title: OS swap (A)
combos.detail: Ajazz manuals disagree on A vs S. One of these two is Mac, the other is Windows — tap both once and watch whether Cmd/Win swap.

combos.title: OS swap (S)
combos.detail: The other half of the Win / Mac pair. F-row media bindings follow the active OS.

combos.title: Lock Windows key
combos.detail: Win key lights to show it is locked. Press again to unlock. Mac mode ignores this.

combos.title: Factory reset
combos.detail: Board flashes three times. Clears lighting presets and wireless pairings. Does not need the Windows driver.

lightsOut.copy: FN+X toggles. Or FN+↓ until dark. Or FN+\ until the off effect.
